title: Chaar Pandav bina yuddh ke kaise dharashayi hue?
hooks: Mahabharata ke chaar sabse shaktishali yoddha bina yuddh ke achanak bejaan kaise pad gaye?
Ek ghoont paani ne chaar mahabali yoddhaon ko kaise mita diya?
Duniya ka sabse bada aashcharya kya hai? Yaksha ka wo sawal jisne Pandavon ko hila diya.
hook_why: Immediate high-stakes paradox: four unconquerable warriors fall unconscious not to weapons or armies, but to a mysterious sip of water.
metaphor: The Enchanted Lake of Truth: a clear mirror reflecting the lethal poison of pride and the lifesaving power of humble wisdom.

caption:
Mahabharata ka Yaksha Prashna prasang sikhata hai ki taqat se bada dhairya hota hai, aur ghamand se bada gyan. Jab chaar mahan yoddha pyaas aur aatmavishwas mein gir gaye, tab keval Yudhishthir ki vinamrata ne unhein bachaya.

Agar aap us talab par hote, toh kya pyaas ke samne itna dhairya rakh paate? Comment mein batayein!

claims.claim: Yaksha Prashna episode takes place during the Pandavas' exile in the Aranya/Vana Parva of the Mahabharata.
claims.basis: Mahabharata Critical Edition, Vana Parva, Adhyaya 311-314.

claims.claim: Yudhishthira answers that the mind is swifter than wind, and the greatest wonder is mortal beings living as if they will never die.
claims.basis: Mahabharata, Vana Parva, Yaksha Prashna verses.

claims.claim: Pleased with Yudhishthira's answers and humility, the Yaksha (Lord Dharma in disguise) revives all four brothers.
claims.basis: Mahabharata, Vana Parva, conclusion of the Yaksha Prashna section.
